name: dohdec-monorepo
description: DNS over HTTPS and DNS over TLS

scripts.preall:check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run all:types && npm run all:docs
scripts.all:types: pnpm run -C pkg/dohdec types && pnpm run -C pkg/dohdec-cli types
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules coverage pkg/*/node_modules pkg/*/coverage pkg/*/types
scripts.version: monopub version && pnpm run -r --if-present version && pnpm i -r && git add pnpm-lock.yaml

author: Joe Hildebrand <joe-github@cursive.net>
